evidence: Workbook (frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx, read via zipfile in memory): Quality Checks row 31 (#30, block E) and Internal Quality Checks row 31 carry the same text: 'Any rejects / hides / absent check is paired with the matching success case, so a totally broken app can't earn it.' No extra internal annotation or threaded comment exists for this row (persons/person.xml empty; no comments part). Skill references/quality-checks.md:127-129: verify every rejects/hides/absent/unchanged leg is paired inside the same criterion with the matching success case; defect = a check a blank app, empty DB or login screen passes by absence of evidence. REVIEW_POLICY 'A negative needs a successful control' read and applied. Global rule: task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:17 'Every refusal leg needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this session.'; prompt.md:25 also voids false-credit refusals ('A refusal that only reports the card as changed or out of date does not count as that rule's or role's refusal'; 'a refusal for a duplicate, a skip or a full stage does not count as the role refusal'; a stale undo identifier does not count; an unexpressible forbidden target passes only when 'the allowed action of the same kind succeeded as its control'); prompt.md:29 timed negatives watch the full 15000 ms and define void attempts (Colderwater lessons 7/14); gates in functional prompt.md:15-17, polish/prompt.md:11-12 and visual/prompt.md:11-12 zero a static shell or no-op save. Per-criterion pairing in task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: hro_intake_restart (l.31) blank title/0/51/2.5/recruiter-as-manager refusals vs J1/J2 openings; invalid and different-case email refusals vs 'the same address on J2 is accepted' and A-F added; 'not loaded again' vs seeded jobs appear once and everything recorded unchanged. hro_moves (l.40) skips refused vs one-stage moves. hro_reject_reopen (l.49) blank reason vs reasoned reject; wrong-stage reopens vs correct reopen; Hired reject refused vs C/E rejects. hro_two_people (l.58) 409 with 'The original move is the control.' hro_interview_places (l.67) 'A and B entering Interview are the control'; refused undo vs the same undo going ahead once a place frees. hro_bulk (l.76) refused sets with 'steps 3, 6 and 9 are the control'. hro_undo (l.85) refused undos (steps 3,4,6,7,8) vs successful undos in steps 1,3,5. hro_activity (l.94) 'the refused attempts added no line' and 'only this job's' vs lines required for every successful action and 'all of this job's lines'. hro_manager_roles (l.103) Ingrid refusals with 'Rafael's identical requests are the control'; Bill refusals with 'Ingrid's move is the control' plus Rafael/Ingrid notes saved. hro_readonly_roles (l.112) Observer/candidate/anonymous refusals vs 'the session controls' and 'the same-kind controls', kinds without a working control left out, and 'if no kind has a successful control, this criterion is 0'. hro_messaging (l.121) blank/role/404 refusals vs 'Rafael's own read and send are the controls', Mei and Bill writes. hro_drafts (l.130) empty-after-send vs drafts surviving switch/Board/reload. hro_long_thread (l.139) 'does not move his place'/'stays unread' vs notice within 15 s and 'then it is read'. hro_unread_seen (l.148) 'does not raise either'/'still not seen after only the Observer' vs rise by exactly two and seen after Tomas/Bill/Rafael open. hro_candidate (l.157) privacy absences vs own applications, statuses and conversations shown and 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data makes this criterion 0'; staff-read replay refused 'while Rafael's identical read succeeded'. Gates/polish/visual: gates/render/judge.toml:25 wrong password leaves visitor signed out vs correct password signs in (render/prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'); gates/constraints/judge.toml:25 is positive-only (add, reload, Observer readback). scored/polish/judge.toml: live_board (l.25) and live_thread (l.34) preservation negatives require the update to arrive ('If no update arrives within 60 seconds ... this row is 0'); earlier_place (l.43) requires 'the earlier ones above it'; failed_send (l.52) 'nothing was sent' vs resend 'sent once'; session_resume (l.61) 'nothing was sent'/Mei sees empty boxes vs reply as left and sends ('the positive control') and Rafael's drafts still there after Mei's visit. Visual rows are Likert craft with no negative legs. Broken-app probes: blank/static shell -> gate 0 everywhere; app refusing every write -> hro_moves/hro_bulk/hro_manager_roles/hro_undo controls fail; app answering 409 to everything -> role/rule refusals do not count (prompt.md:25); candidate endpoint returning nothing -> hro_candidate 0; no live updates -> polish preservation rows 0 and timed functional legs fail. Conforming alternatives (UI not offering forbidden moves, one-stage-only controls, reopen without a stage choice) are accommodated by prompt.md:25 replay/unexpressible rules, so they are not failed for lacking a negative UI path. No counterexample found. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json re-verified (8 entries' sha256 match; their matching_source_files equal the frozen solution bytes). qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json shows 26 golden groups passed (e.g. #2 refused-when-full with reorder/freed place, #4 role refusals 401/403/404, #6 bulk all-or-nothing, #22 ended session nothing sent then resumes) so golden refusals coexist with their successful controls. No configured judge run, no broken/weak-app discrimination run and no Oracle exist (index scope says so); whether the GLM judge honours the controls on a dead or partial app is unmeasured, so risk=true as a missing-evidence flag, not a source defect. Notes (non-blocking): (1) the template functional prompt says 'A positive control must come before every negative claim'; the task's wording (prompt.md:17) only requires the control 'observed in this session', and some controls come after the negative (hro_unread_seen seen-after-Tomas; hro_interview_places later undo). Because the bars are conjunctive they still exclude dead apps, so this is not a row-30 defect. (2) hro_manager_roles names 'Ingrid's move' as the control for Bill's note; the note's same-kind control is the 'Rafael's and Ingrid's notes are saved' leg in the same bar, so pairing exists but the wording could name it. (3) hro_messaging's 'after the reload the sent text does not reappear' has only the send as control within that criterion (draft persistence is paired in hro_drafts); it cannot be earned by a dead app because the criterion requires sending to work.
